reviews.comment: Technically, the main prof is Kebo, and Quinn is just an assistant (CSCE 416). But Quinn is rude to everyone for absolutely no reason. He even antagonizes Kebo. You simply cannot ask a question in the class discord without him sniffing his own farts and insulting you. Go to the TA or Kebo instead; this guy is just going to waste your time.
Loved his advanced verification class and he gives access to cadence verification courses too. They are really expensive. Difficult if you don't have any clue about verification. But loved the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is the first semester he has done online lecture, and it's the most chill CSCE 121 class compared to the other ones. Weekly homeworks, two exams, and an extra credit project. The homeworks get progressively difficult, however Dr. Quinn is accessible to answer questions online and through his office hours. Overall, not bad of a professor.
Knows his information, but does not answer questions without degrading you. Unless you go to his office hours, expect him to skip answering your questions for lack of time.
This guy seems to know his stuff, but he is a colossal arsehole. Do not ask any questions and expect to get an honest, useful response. You'll probably just get called an idiot in one way or another.

I took him for CSCE 121 and it was his first semester teaching it. He worked in the industry for several years and knows his stuff about C++. He did programming assignments every week that would get harder and harder. Overall, he is good and I would take him again for another CS class.
